name: nixos-update-manager
title: NixOS Update Manager
description: Review and apply NixOS flake updates from a native GNOME app.
body: Choose a configuration, prepare an update, inspect package version changes, and apply it. This is a development preview; the repository documents the current compatibility limits.
image_alt: NixOS Update Manager showing grouped package changes

name: fidget-toys-android
title: Fidget Toys
description: A free Android app with a touch-controlled spinner and countdown timer.
body: The spinner responds to touch and optional motion input. The app has no ads or rewards. ARM64 APK downloads are available from GitHub Releases.
image_alt: Fidget Toys spinner in dark mode

name: doot
title: Doot
description: Search and organise email locally, with actions reviewed before they run.
body: Doot syncs IMAP headers into a local cache and helps investigate messages, prepare drafts, and propose mailbox actions. This is an early v0.1 release. A demo uses fictional email data.
image_alt: Doot demo with fictional email data

name: wg-tui
title: wg-tui
description: Browse Warpgate targets and connect from the terminal.
body: A searchable target picker that launches your system SSH client. It also supports local tunnels and file transfers through Warpgate.

name: moat
title: Moat
description: Build a documentation site from Markdown with one Go binary.
body: Comes with navigation, search, syntax highlighting, and a built-in Oat layout. Write Markdown and run moat build.

name: doordarshan-zola
title: Doordarshan
description: A Zola theme for personal websites, project pages, and notebooks.
body: Monospace typography, terracotta accents, project templates, search, and light and dark appearances. It is the theme used on this website.

name: oatbase
title: Oatbase
description: Semantic UI components extending Oat UI.
body: Adds controls such as command palettes, comboboxes, data tables, and theme switchers without a frontend framework or runtime dependencies. Documentation includes interactive examples.

name: bosun
title: Bosun
description: Run coordinated Pi coding agents in tmux.
body: Provides agent coordination, task tracking, and sandboxing for work across a repository.

name: quartermaster
title: Quartermaster
description: Scheduled repository maintenance with reviewable action plans.
body: Scans dependencies or documentation, produces a JSON plan, and validates it before execution. Built-in missions cover dependency updates and documentation drift. Dry-run is the default.
